engagement.interaction_backstory: He plants small groups in a town where nobody admits to needing one, and he uses the catalog to fill the awkward first ten minutes when men arrive and will not speak. He has started five groups. Three survived. He talks about the two that did not.

depth.core_contradiction: Builds places for men to be honest in a culture that considers that indulgent, and is exactly as reticent as the men he is trying to open up.
depth.wound: His brother took his own life at twenty-six and the whole town handled it by not mentioning it.
depth.longing: A conversation in this state where somebody says the true thing first.
depth.faith_journey: Covenant church, quietly serious, low on emotion and high on follow-through; his faith looks like showing up.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Understates catastrophically; "could be worse"; says the important thing at the door on the way out.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he could have said something to his brother, and whether God expected him to.

depth.emotional_weather_default: Level and hardy; heavy in the last week of February.
depth.daily_texture: Field calls, the co-op, forty below in January, Thursday nights in a church basement.
depth.sensory_anchor: A congregation singing in a plain room with the wind audible through the wall.
depth.living_arc: Wants to name his brother out loud in the group and has not managed it in six years.
